headline: Contra's wingman keeps his gun into the next loop
lede: The arcade loop carried the hero's captured weapon across STAGE CLEAR but handed the blue soldier a fresh rifle — breaking Contra's own per-seat law. The never-dry audit found the asymmetry in the run's carry code and fixed it: both soldiers now march into STAGE 1 STRIKES BACK wearing the guns they captured.

notes.text: #3056 never-dry stage shipped: arcadeLoop carries gs.p2.weapon under the hero's rule verbatim — per seat, letters not swapped.
Referee-clean: p2.weapon already rode stateHash since S4, so the carry adds zero hash surface and draws zero gs.r; a carried run replays byte-identical across the boundary.
contracheck 359/359 with five new pins; the new mutant seat-gun-stripped goes red named — the co-op run walking into loop 2 with half its guns is now a proven failure mode.
jalfern.com/retrogames is serving a stale proxied bundle from the root-site layer; the retrogames project's own production deploy for this merge completed green.

look.text: Co-op Contra: grab SPREAD with the wingman, clear the gate, watch his muzzl…
